description: This file defines the main activity for an Android application demonstrating shortcuts. It manages a ViewPager with three tabs, each hosting different fragments related to app list, pinned shortcuts, and shortcut creation. It sets up tab navigation and overrides back button behavior.

classes.name: ShortcutLauncherMain
classes.description: Main activity class managing UI with tabs and ViewPager for shortcut demonstration.

classes.name: MyPagerAdapter
classes.description: An adapter subclass for managing fragments displayed within the ViewPager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and configures the tab navigation.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides default back button behavior to do nothing.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment based on the tab position.

methods.name: setPrimaryItem
methods.description: Syncs tab selection with the current fragment displayed.
